Description
Take your streetwear rotation into pole position. The PUMA x McLaren F1 Team Vegas Track Jacket brings trackside energy to everyday styling, combining motorsport-inspired detailing with a classic athletic silhouette. Featuring bold McLaren team branding and a race-ready aesthetic, this standout layer delivers serious Formula 1 attitude. Cop yours today at Culture Kings.

RETURNS

CULTURE KINGS CHANGE OF MIND RETURN POLICY
You can return your purchase for a full refund, an exchange or store credit within 30 days if you change your mind, provided the following conditions are met.
 
RETURN CONDITIONS

  • Items must be unworn, unwashed, and unused
  • All original tags and labels must be attached
  • Items must be returned with original packaging (e.g., shoeboxes, protective cases, product sleeves)
  • Items must be in resellable condition, free from damage, wear, or scent
  • You must provide proof of purchase (order number, confirmation email, or store receipt)

NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS
The following items are not eligible for return due to hygiene or sale conditions:

  • Face masks
  • Intimate apparel (including underwear and bodysuits)
  • Swimwear
  • Earrings
  • Gift cards
  • Items marked as Final Sale
